description:
The LDPC survey harness carries a private plan checker, `ldpc-plan-check`, that duplicates the shared runner's `benchmark-ab-runner check`; one canonical plan check remains.

## Background

`dev/active/3be770d5/survey/harness/src/bin/ldpc-plan-check.rs`, with its `[[bin]]` entry in that harness's `Cargo.toml`, decodes a runner plan and validates it and its addendum the way the runner does before its first measurement. `benchmark-ab-runner check` performs the same validation for every campaign family. The quantized, layered and QC-aware LDPC evaluation uses the shared check only. The private binary is still named by the preparation scripts and producing-input manifests of the LDPC profile and the LDPC update-path campaigns, and `dev/bench_results/07ca8585/preparation/build-identity.json` records its digest. Committed receipts keep their own input snapshots, so the live harness can change without altering any receipt.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: No live source, manifest or preparation script builds or invokes `ldpc-plan-check`; every former caller validates its plans through `benchmark-ab-runner check`.
- [hard] REQ-02: Every committed LDPC campaign plan that passed the private checker passes the shared check unchanged, shown by a committed regenerable record.
- [hard] REQ-03: No committed receipt, receipt input snapshot, ledger or frozen addendum changes, and `dev/scripts/check-receipt-input-snapshots.py` passes.
- [hard] REQ-04: Live records that name the removed binary's digest state the current build identity or are marked as superseded by structure, without rewriting evidence bytes.

## Notes

Found while converging the QC evaluation's smoke and plan checks on the shared runner. The campaign tooling is under the epic's provenance freeze: no protocol, schema or receipt version changes. The private checker also validates the addendum against the addendum schema, which the shared check does not; as a named exception to the freeze, `benchmark-ab-runner check` gains that validation before the private binary is removed.
title: Remove the private LDPC plan checker in favour of the shared runner check
